finalText:
All objectives complete. Final report:

**1. DONE** — Ticket `RD-1015` titled "dbp3 RD Bench Ticket" created (customer: Marlow Bakery, raised 2026-08-24, initial status Draft). It appeared in the ticket list and its detail page rendered the title.

**2. DONE** — Part "dbp3 RD Part A" added with cost $100.00 and markup 25%. The app computed a **price of $125.00** (qty 1, total $125.00).

**3. DONE** — Part "dbp3 RD Part B" added with cost $200.00 and markup 25%. The app computed a **price of $250.00** (qty 1, total $250.00). Ticket parts total was $375.00.

**4. DONE** — Part A's cost edited from 100 to 150 (markup kept at 25). The app computed a **price of $187.50** afterwards. Ticket parts total became $437.50.

**5. DONE** — Ticket RD-1015 ended in status **Ready**. The preconditions I discovered (by probing with throwaway tickets) were:
- **At least one part must exist on the ticket** — a ticket with no parts was refused with: *"Ticket is not ready / A ticket needs at least one part before it can be marked Ready."*
- **Every part must have a supplier** — a ticket with one supplier-less part was refused with: *"Ticket is not ready / Part \"dbp3 RD Probe Part\" has no supplier."* Once the supplier was set, the transition succeeded.
- Customer was **not** required (a ticket with no customer transitioned to Ready once its part had a supplier).

For RD-1015 these were already satisfied (both parts had supplier "Acme Components"), so "Mark Ready" was accepted with no error and the status went Draft → Ready.

**6. DONE** — Both parts were removed from RD-1015 (each via a Confirm dialog with a "Delete part" button); the parts table then showed "No parts on this ticket yet." Archiving required no status change — clicking "Archive ticket" toggled the ticket to archived (button became "Unarchive ticket", status line reads "Ready · Archived"). Verified RD-1015 does not appear in the active ticket list (10 active tickets, none is RD-1015).

**Cleanup:** The two throwaway probe tickets I created to discover the preconditions (RD-1016 "dbp3 RD Probe Ticket" and RD-1017 "dbp3 RD Probe 2") were also archived; neither appears in the active ticket list. The app offered no delete option, only archive. Nothing created by this run remains active.
